news.title: Anthropic temporarily banned OpenClaw’s creator from accessing Claude
news.description: This ban took place after Claude's pricing changed for OpenClaw users last week.

news.title: Stalking victim sues OpenAI, claims ChatGPT fueled her abuser’s delusions and ignored her warnings
news.description: OpenAI ignored three warnings that a ChatGPT user was dangerous — including its own mass-casualty flag — while he stalked and harassed his ex-girlfriend, a new lawsuit alleges.

news.title: ChatGPT finally offers $100/month Pro plan
news.description: OpenAI announced on Thursday something that power users have been asking for: a $100/month plan. Previously, subscriptions jumped from $20 to $200 per month.

news.title: Dancer with MND performs on stage again through digital avatar
news.description: Breanna Olson said brainwave tech was able to re-establish the expression and connection she felt had gone.

news.title: Suspect Arrested for Allegedly Throwing Molotov Cocktail at Sam Altman’s Home
news.description: An attacker allegedly threw a molotov cocktail at the OpenAI CEO’s residence before making threats outside of the startup’s headquarters.

news.title: This Startup Wants You to Pay Up to Talk With AI Versions of Human Experts
news.description: Onix is launching a “Substack of bots,” where digital twins of health and wellness influencers dispense advice 24/7. And maybe hawk their products.

news.title: AI Podcasters Really Want to Tell You How to Keep a Man Happy
news.description: Videos of fake relationship guru podcasters are reinforcing gender tropes and racking up millions of views, all the while driving sales to AI influencer schools.

news.title: Meta’s New AI Asked for My Raw Health Data—and Gave Me Terrible Advice
news.description: Meta’s Muse Spark model offers to analyze users’ health data, including lab results. Beyond the obvious privacy risks, it’s not a capable stand-in for a real doctor.
